mistakes.dont: Selling every gem-icon valuable the moment you extract.
mistakes.do: Some 3D Printer upgrades need valuables. Track the recipe first, then sell only what you don't need.
mistakes.src: dmzcodex 3D printer guide; modernwarfare.wiki crafting guide; metaradar money guide; Waffles 9:21

mistakes.dont: Opening the tac map and only checking the full view.
mistakes.do: Zoom in on your area. Smaller locations and icons are much easier to spot up close.
mistakes.src: callofduty.com Hajin deep dive (tac map zoom); codcentral map guide (minor locations show when zoomed); Waffles 18:13

mistakes.dont: Wasting the whole match on a Dynamic Op you can't finish.
mistakes.do: Vote to cancel it on the tac map, then grab a better op.
mistakes.src: callofduty.com Hajin deep dive (cancel your current Op on the tac map); codcentral dynamic ops (vote to cancel); Waffles 17:52

mistakes.dont: Tanking the Deathstalker's dual machine guns out in the open.
mistakes.do: Pull it over a SAM site and capture it. The launcher shoots it down. First kill pays up to $50K.
mistakes.src: callofduty.com FOB deep dive (Deathstalker, first-kill cash); callofduty.com Hajin deep dive (SAM vs Deathstalker); allthings.how Deathstalker guide ($50,000 bounty); Waffles 12:55

mistakes.dont: Paying for guns while your blueprints sit unused.
mistakes.do: Gunsmith (DMZ level 10) › Buy New Weapon › Blueprints. Your first copy of each blueprint you own is FREE.
mistakes.src: allthings.how blueprints guide (first copy free, level 10); metaradar money guide; Waffles 15:29
